logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of the Pt(II) complexes was assessed using a “shake flask” method, utilizing n-octanol and deionized water phase partition. A specified amount of the Pt(II) complexes (0.001 g/10 mL) was mixed with a 10 mL blend of n-octanol and deionized water in equal. The mixture was continuously shaken for 24 h to reach equilibrium. Subsequently, the organic (n-octanol) and aqueous (deionized water) phases were carefully separated. The concentration of the metal complex in aqueous phase was determined using ICP spectroscopy. This information was then used to calculate the partition coefficient (log P) using the equation log P = log ([Pt] in octanol/[Pt] in aqueous) [30].
